   - Red Dye: 1 poppy → 1 red dye
   - White Dye: 1 bone meal → 1 white dye

   - Red Dye: 1 poppy → 1 red dye

   - Pink Dye: 1 red dye + 1 white dye → 1 pink dye
   - Now we have 3 pink dyes, which is enough to make 1 pink wool.

   - Acacia Planks: 4 acacia planks → 1 acacia log → 4 acacia planks
